avoid_when: Avoid when the slide needs a visible title, explanatory copy, or multiple content regions.
Avoid when the visual must fill the entire canvas or be paired with detailed analysis.

page_semantics.summary: A sparse visual-evidence slide centered on one large portrait-oriented reference image against a decorative background.

regions.description: Single dominant reference image, map, diagram scan, or other visual exhibit presented for inspection.

selection_hints: Use for presenting one large reference image or scanned visual artifact.
Choose when the image itself carries the message and requires no accompanying text.
